title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
overview: After reincarnating in another world as a mere goblin, Akira's skills from his former life serve him well.

title: So What's Wrong with Meeting a Sly Old Fox?
overview: The local border count turns out to defy expectations when Akira goes to parley with him.

title: So What's Wrong with Negotiating with Humans?
overview: The goblins are growing more powerful, so Akira seeks to improve public opinion of them amongst humans.

title: So What's Wrong with Being an Assassination Target?
overview: Various attempts on Akira's life prompt him to reach a new understanding with Karen and Simon.

title: So What's Wrong with Being Disliked by an Adolescent Elf?
overview: When Eunomia gets jealous of her sister Diké giving Akira attention, will anything persuade her otherwise?
